# M20 Golos, Tireless Pilgrim.
# [0] "When Golos enters, you may search your library for a land card, put that card onto the
#     battlefield tapped, then shuffle." M21 Solemn Simulacrum's tree (B2b-etb-basic-land) with
#     "a land card" for "a basic land card".
# [1] "{2}{W}{U}{B}{R}{G}: Exile the top three cards of your library. You may play them this turn
#     without paying their mana costs." The library pop of three (M21 Chandra, Heart of Fire's
#     [+1], ontology round R13), then the permission over the cards it exiled (the result
#     register; templates_b19 B19-play-result's tree for "You may play them this turn without
#     paying their mana costs.").
search = A(Verb.SEARCH, {
    "cards": Selector(
        count=QConst(value=1),
        mode=SelectorMode.CHOOSE,
        filter=FAtom(pred=FAtomPred.TYPE_EQ, string_value="Land"),
        zones=(Zone(kind=ZoneKind.LIBRARY, controller=ControllerRef.YOU),),
    ),
    "destination": Zone(kind=ZoneKind.BATTLEFIELD, controller=ControllerRef.YOU),
    "tapped_on_enter": True,
})
shuffle = A(Verb.SHUFFLE, {"zone": Zone(kind=ZoneKind.LIBRARY, controller=ControllerRef.YOU)})
enters = TriggeredAbility(
    event=ZoneChangeEvent(
        from_zone=Zone(kind=ZoneKind.ANY, controller=ControllerRef.ANY),
        to_zone=Zone(kind=ZoneKind.BATTLEFIELD, controller=ControllerRef.YOU),
        subject=FAtom(pred=FAtomPred.IS_SOURCE),
    ),
    condition=None,
    effect=OptionalEffect(inner=Seq(steps=(search, shuffle))),
)
exile_three = A(Verb.MOVE_ZONE, {
    "amount": QConst(value=3),
    "controller": ControllerRef.YOU,
    "destination": Zone(kind=ZoneKind.EXILE, controller=ControllerRef.OWNER),
    "from": Zone(kind=ZoneKind.LIBRARY, controller=ControllerRef.YOU),
    "pop_order": "TOP",
})
play_them = A(Verb.PERMIT, {
    "alternative": Cost(),
    "duration": DurationEot(),
    "lands": True,
    "source": Selector(
        count=QConst(value=1),
        mode=SelectorMode.CHOOSE,
        filter=FAnd(children=()),
        zones=(Zone(kind=ZoneKind.ANY, controller=ControllerRef.ANY),),
        referent="result",
    ),
})
impulse = ActivatedAbility(
    cost=Cost(parts=(
        CostManaGeneric(amount=QConst(value=2)),
        CostManaColor(color="W", amount=QConst(value=1)),
        CostManaColor(color="U", amount=QConst(value=1)),
        CostManaColor(color="B", amount=QConst(value=1)),
        CostManaColor(color="R", amount=QConst(value=1)),
        CostManaColor(color="G", amount=QConst(value=1)),
    )),
    effect=Seq(steps=(exile_three, play_them)),
)
(carrier,) = compiled
abilities = [enters, impulse, carrier]

clauses.clause: When Golos enters, you may search your library for a land card, put that card onto the battlefield tapped, then shuffle.
clauses.evidence: Trace [cast] and [cast | ask 1 -> skip]: 'ask may [fire, skip]' and "card's triggered ability [0] triggers"; [from your hand ... opponent's turn] triggers too; no other stimulus triggers it. The probe library holds no land, so nothing is found or moved. Packs A00_1 (a nonbasic land, Cryptic Caves, is picked from three lands and enters tapped; the others stay), A00_2 (a nonland, Shock, is not offered by the search ask), A00_3 (skip: nothing moves). The shuffle has no runner lane: checked directly, the executor's event list holds ('SHUFFLE', player:0, library) after A00_1 (search taken) and nothing after A00_3 (skipped), and the tree has SHUFFLE of YOUR library after the SEARCH inside the optional Seq.

clauses.clause: {2}{W}{U}{B}{R}{G}: Exile the top three cards of your library.
clauses.evidence: Trace [activate [1] from battlefield]: 'mana B-1 C-2 G-1 R-1 U-1 W-1' (the whole cost), three 'you:Library N moves library -> exile (by card/MOVE_ZONE)' rows, 'you: library 6 -> 3' (the top three of the controller's library; the opponent's is untouched, A00_4 pins its library order). Packs A00_4, A00_5, A00_8 exile the top three (Mountain, Shock, Leafkin Druid) and leave the fourth card (Murder).

clauses.clause: You may play them this turn without paying their mana costs.
clauses.evidence: The trace activates the ability but plays nothing. Packs: A00_4 (the Mountain is played from exile as the land drop, Shock is cast from exile with an empty pool and an untapped Mountain, i.e. free; Leafkin Druid stays), A00_5 (a creature card cast free from exile resolves), A00_6 (a later turn: no row), A00_7 (a graveyard card, a card exiled earlier and the fourth library card are not covered; the menu offers exactly the Mountain, Shock and the Druid), A00_8 (activated on the opponent's turn: the instant is cast, the creature and the land are not offered), A00_9 (a land played from exile is the land drop: the second land is not offered). A00_10: 'without paying their MANA costs' waives the mana cost only: Bone Splinters cast from exile for no mana still has its additional cost (sacrifice a creature) paid (CR 118.9d).
